front.title: An Agentic AI Security Framework for Security Management in Mobile Networks

abstract.t: This document proposes an Agentic AI Security Framework for security management in mobile networks. A Security Application Function (SAF) Agent translates a network administrator's security intent to hold security objectives into a high-level security policy. A Security Control Function (SCF) Agent receives the high-level policy and translates it into a low-level security policy that will be enforced by distributed Network Security Functions (NSFs) in mobile networks. The SCF Agent sends the low-level security policy to an apporiate NSF. Policy generation, monitoring, and continuity across a data path are integrated into a closed-loop control with an Observe- Reason-Act-Verify process. The proposed framework can be applied to enterprise, campus, cloud, and edge networks along with existing network-management mechanisms. This document describes the architecture, a policy-continuity example, standard integration points, and security considerations.
